quantity: DockQ score of a predicted pose that qualifies as an acceptable-quality prediction (CAPRI acceptable or better), for a PINDER-S case
source: brief.md: 'DockQ >= 0.23 defines an acceptable-quality prediction under the standard benchmark convention.' This is the community DockQ/CAPRI convention as recorded in the brief; no primary publication was fetched during this intake, and the pinned PINDER source does not contain this cut-off (its capri_class() classifies from Fnat/iRMS/LRMS instead).
note: Published acceptance criterion expressed as a threshold: measured DockQ >= 0.23 means the pose is acceptable-quality. Tolerance is ignored for inequalities and none is invented.
